thread:
rachel: FYI sequoia21b-int4 canary started showing sporadic OOMs after we enabled microbatch_shim and the new dynamic-kv-prefetcher. Low traffic but OOMs concentrate on long-history sessions (>1200). Repro logs attached.

 tom: When did microbatch_shim land? Might be increasing peak simultaneous allocations.

 rachel: It landed yesterday evening with the allocator alignment tweak. Log snippet: 

 ```
 # /var/log/inference/sequoia-canary.log
 [2026-01-17T04:42:11Z] ERROR oom: gpu_alloc failed 62914560 bytes at gpu_pool.cc:101
 [2026-01-17T04:42:11Z] INFO seq_len=1475 prefetch_slots=36 kv_cache=1.4GB post_frag=0.69
 [2026-01-17T04:42:11Z] INFO serving-config: max_new_tokens=384 batch_size=6 prefetch=dynamic microbatch_shim=on
 ```

 evan: I ran a quick stress matrix (20k requests, 50/50 short/long):
 - baseline canary config: OOM_rate 11% when seq>1200, p95 470ms
 - config A: max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=3, prefetch=moderate => OOM_rate 1.1%, p95 520ms
 - config B: A + compactor.interval=75s + kv_trim_threshold=0.55 + soft_reserve=1.1GB => OOM_rate 0.2%, p95 540ms
 tradeoff: higher latency but stable.

 priya: Sounds like we should ship a per-model safety profile rather than globally toggling microbatch_shim off. Also consider a microbatch-cap: cap microbatch_shim to 2 concurrent microbatches for sequoia.

 tom: Agreed. Proposed sequoia profile:
 - model.profile.max_new_tokens = "128"
 - model.profile.max_batch_size = "3"
 - model.profile.prefetch = "moderate"
 - runtime.kv_trim_threshold = "0.55"
 - compactor.interval = "75s"
 - runtime.soft_reserve = "1.1GB"
 - runtime.microbatch_concurrency = "2"
 - fallback.variant = "sequoia21b-int8" when session_len > 800 or oom_rate > 1.5%
 - pod.kernel_fallback = "alloc-align-512" if alloc_failures > 4% in 10m

 rachel: Add a soft-evict: evict oldest KV segments when free_mem < 1.0GB. That helped on my repro runs. Also add a small slab-defrag pass during compaction to reduce external fragmentation.

 evan: I'll queue a Redwood Optimize eval: convo-bench (60% short, 40% long), deterministic seeds, compare int4 new-profile vs int8 & fp16. Metrics: OOM_rate, quality (ROUGE-L + BLEU), p95 latency, memfrag traces. Estimated run ~2h.

 ops-bot: @rachel canary-config "sequoia21b: safe-profile-v1" applied to canary pool (8% traffic) by ops-bot at 2876543280 :wrench:

 eval-bot: Eval queued: convos-bench 60/40, seeds fixed, variants: int4 safe-profile-v1 vs int8 vs fp16. ETA 2h.

 priya: Add monitoring rules: canary oom_rate > 2% over 10m => auto-rollback; memfrag > 0.66 for >5m => pager. Also block auto-promotion if quality drift > 0.8% ROUGE-L.

 tom: Also include a kernel-level fallback: if microbatch_shim reports alloc_ratings > 3% failures in last 5m, disable microbatch_shim for that pod and prefer larger-batch path. Safer than full rollback.

 rachel: I'll draft the PR with profile + compactor tweak + runbook. Runbook will include quick revert steps, how to force int8 fallback for a single deployment, and how to read memfrag waterfall charts.

 evan: (later) Eval results: int4 + safe-profile-v1: OOM_rate 0.4% (down from 11%), ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 = -0.2%, BLEU delta = -0.1%, avg latency +7%. int8 fallback: OOM_rate 0%, ROUGE-L delta -1.1%, latency +3%. Recommendation: keep int4 with safe-profile-v1, auto-fallback to int8 for sessions>800 or if oom alert triggers.

 priya: Good. I'll add the canary rules and compactor defaults to the ops runbook and prevent auto-promotion if memfrag spikes.

 rachel: PR: https://git.redwood/inference/infra/patches/3347 - includes model profile, microbatch cap, compactor slab-defrag, kernel-fallback, and runbook. Merging after 1h if no objections.

 ops-bot: PR 3347 CI: green.

 tom: No objections. Merge on green and promote: 8% -> 30% after 45m stable -> 70% after 3h stable -> full. Auto-rollback if oom_rate > 1.5% or quality drift > 0.8% ROUGE-L.

 rachel: Thanks team. Will update onboarding docs and release notes. :rocket:
